# Adecco

> Adecco is a global staffing and talent acquisition company offering temporary, flexible, and permanent placement solutions, workforce training, and specialized recruitment services across multiple industries.

Adecco provides comprehensive workforce solutions for employers including temporary staffing, permanent recruitment, outsourcing (RPO/BPO), training, and diversity-focused hiring. The platform serves industries ranging from healthcare and manufacturing to hospitality and energy sectors across North America, South America, and Europe.

## Key Topics

- Talent Acquisition
- Temporary Staffing
- Permanent Placement
- Flexible Staffing
- Workforce Solutions
- RPO/BPO
- Staff Augmentation
- Recruitment Services
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Workforce Planning

- Manufacturing
- Healthcare
- Logistics & Transportation
- Gen AI

## Employer Services & Solutions

- [Temporary Staffing & Talent Acquisition Services](https://www.adecco.com/employers): Adecco's main employer services for temporary staffing and talent acquisition
- [Flexible Staffing Solutions & Services](https://www.adecco.com/employers/solutions/flexible-placement): Adecco's flexible staffing solution for temporary workforce optimization
- [Permanent Staffing & Placement Solutions](https://www.adecco.com/employers/solutions/permanent-recruitment): Adecco's permanent staffing and talent placement service for employers
- [Outsourced Staffing & Recruitment Solutions](https://www.adecco.com/employers/solutions/outsourcing): Adecco's RPO and BPO recruitment outsourcing and staffing management
- [Diversity Staffing & Inclusion Recruitment](https://www.adecco.com/employers/solutions/diversity-and-inclusion): Adecco's DEI-focused staffing and inclusive recruitment solutions
- [Corporate Training & Employee Development](https://www.adecco.com/employers/solutions/training): Adecco's corporate training and workforce development programs
- [How Adecco Staffing Process Works](https://www.adecco.com/employers/how-we-work): Guide to Adecco's staffing process using MSP and MVP programs

## Industry-Specific Staffing

- [Adecco Healthcare | Your Partner in Quality Care](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/healthcare): Adecco Healthcare's medical and administrative staffing services
- [Manufacturing Staffing Agency & Recruitment Services](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/manufacturing): Adecco's manufacturing staffing for automotive, plastics, and medical devices
- [Adecco Logistics & Transportation | Driving Efficiency and Excellence](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/logistics-transportation): Adecco's logistics, transportation, and supply chain staffing solutions
- [Automotive, Aerospace & Mobility Staffing Agency](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/automotive-aeronautics-mobility): Adecco's specialized staffing for automotive, aerospace, and mobility sectors
- [Hospitality & Catering Staffing Agency Recruitment](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/catering-and-hospitality): Adecco's hospitality and catering staffing and recruitment services
- [Construction Staffing Agency & Job Placement](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/construction): Adecco's construction staffing and skilled worker placement solutions
- [Finance & Consulting Staffing Experts](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/financial-institutions-consulting): Adecco's finance, banking, fintech, and consulting staffing expertise
- [Energy Sector Staffing Agency](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/energy): Adecco's renewable energy staffing with OSHA and GWO certified talent
- [Adecco Retail Services | Elevating Customer Experiences](https://www.adecco.com/employers/industries/retail-sale-services): Adecco's retail staffing and seasonal workforce solutions
